audit.whatIsWrong: Stored chart is Poppy / Poppy / Poppy / Poppy / Skill / Poppy / Poppy in both layers. The mirror flipped rows 0, 3, 5 and 6 as matched pairs, landing on packet.levelChart: Skill / Poppy / Poppy / Skill / Skill / Skill / Wukong.
audit.why: This page's whys already describe the mirror's chart — whys[0] 'so it reads Skill', whys[3] 'even out', whys[5] 'the lane stays even', whys[6] 'favoring you'. Four rows showed a winner their own sentence denied, and a 55.61% win rate does not support Poppy taking six of seven stages.
audit.corrected: Flipped rows 0, 3 and 5 to Skill and row 6 to Wukong in BOTH layers as one atomic paired group, ratings moved with them (5/10 on the Skill rows, 6/10 at two items).

audit.whatIsWrong: Steadfast Presence is treated purely as an active that grounds dashes. Its passive half is missing: it gives her Armor and Magic Resist all the time, and THAT BONUS INCREASES WHEN SHE IS LOW ON HEALTH.
audit.why: It is the reason the finishing burst on a low Poppy keeps coming up short — she gets tankier exactly as you are trying to close, so the kill window is earlier than it looks and Black Cleaver's shred matters more than raw damage.
audit.corrected: Wrote the low-health resist scaling into the first-item spike and gave the W its real 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown and 400 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] says 'her passive blocks a dash's damage'. Iron Ambassador does not block anything — she throws her buckler, it bounces off the target, and SHE CAN WALK OVER TO PICK IT UP FOR A SHIELD. Nothing in her passive interacts with your dash.
audit.why: The two lead to opposite play. A block would mean 'spend a hit to pop it, then commit'. A droppable buckler means the buckler on the ground is a tell and a denial opportunity — she has to walk to it, and standing on that spot is the trade you want, because she is choosing between the shield and her position.
audit.corrected: Replaced the block claim with the real buckler-pickup shield, and added the real numbers everywhere the page was vague: Hammer Shock 430 range on 8/7/6/5/4s leaving a zone that explodes after a delay, Heroic Charge 475 range on 14/13/12/11/10s, Steadfast Presence 20s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is headed 'Get E-pinned on a wall' but its body is unrelated boilerplate, and no cooldown number appears anywhere on the page despite Steadfast Presence being the single stated win condition.
audit.why: 20 seconds at rank 1 is an enormous window for a champion whose whole plan is 'engage when her W is down' — and the page never told the player how long to count.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the don'ts, the do's, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Poppy is called 'he'/'his' in tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d, report[3].t and report[9].t.
audit.why: Visible generation artefact, and it sits directly beside correct 'her' usage in the same paragraph.

notes: The 'her passive blocks a dash's damage' line is the fabrication worth killing: Iron Ambassador is a thrown buckler she picks up for a shield, and it does nothing to your dash. The genuinely new fact recovered here is that Steadfast Presence's resist bonus RISES as her health falls, which is why the finishing burst keeps coming up short — the page had no explanation for that at all. Two claims already on the page could not be verified from this brief and were left untouched rather than restated: that Keeper's Verdict can cancel Cyclone mid-dash, and the '%' framing of Hammer Shock's damage (Riot's text gives no percentage). Both belong in a Wiki pass. Note packet.games is 223 while the brief header says 801.
